services.name: Animal Exhibits
services.desc: Special Hours Alert: Open Sunday, September 13, from 10 AM-1 PM for general admission and 2 PM-5 PM for Sensory Sunday. Registration is required to attend Sensory Sunday. Learn more. Sensory Sundays are thoughtfully designed for neurodivergent guests and individuals with sensory sensitivities who may find traditional museum settings overwhelming. Held quarterly, these special afternoons offer a calmer way to explore CuriOdyssey, with guided science activities, animal encounters, and sensory-friendly spaces throughout the museum and zoo. services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Special Hours Alert: Open Sunday, September 13, from 10 AM-1 PM for general admission and 2 PM-5 PM for Sensory Sunday. Registration is required to attend Sensory Sunday. Learn more. We offer an activities-based, high quality, and self-driven science program designed for children ages 6-9 years old. Throughout each session, students learn skills in scientific inquiry, explore different scientific phenomena, and learn more about the world around them. CuriOdyssey’s summer camp sparks curiosity through hands-on exploration in a safe, inclusive, and learner-driven environment. June through August, we offer one-week camps for campers entering TK through 4th grade in the upcoming school year.
